caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a jewelry piece, possibly a brooch or pendant, with a dark (possibly black or deep blue) and gold color scheme. The central part of the piece has a starburst or snowflake-like design with alternating triangular black segments and small circular gold elements at each point. At the intersections of the black segments, there are smaller silver or pearly spherical accents. Dangling from the central starburst are three elongated teardrop-shaped pendants, each outlined in gold and ending in a small gold bead. Below the main section, a smaller star-shaped component repeats the motif with gold balls at each point and a central silver or pearl accent, from which three smaller teardrop pendants also hang. Surrounding the main colored illustration are three line drawings showing different views of the piece: the leftmost is a back view with clasps and closures visible, the center-right is a side profile showing the layered structure of the elements, and the rightmost shows a profile of a hook or clasp mechanism used to attach the jewelry. The background of the drawing is a light beige color, and there is a signature at the lower left and the words "TWICE ACTUAL SIZE" centered at the bottom.
title: Brooch and Earring
